2:
I got a little worried and came to check it
out, but... it's pretty dead. The "Sorami
Friendship Festival."
3:
It seems... not many customers have
come...
4:
Yeah, the idol's appearance getting
canceled really hurt, huh...
6:
Even if it wasn't my fault, I kinda feel bad
about it...
7: Well, well~. If it isn't Tomo-boy.
9:
V-Vegetable Stand Auntie! I-it's not what
you think! That wasn't my fault...!
10: Oh, that. That doesn't matter anymore.
11:
Huh...? B-but the idol went home, so there
are no customers at all.
12:
That's true. But oh well. Can't be helped.
For a run-down shopping street like this,
this is about the best we can hope for...
13:
Business is as bad as ever, and lately the
customers have dried up completely...
15:
Our vegetable stand's been going since my
grandma's day, but I suppose its time has
finally come...
18:
The idol thing was done by my impostor, so
it's not my fault, but...
19:
But if you want, should I help out with
something? If there's anything I can do,
anyway.
21:
Let's see... Come to think of it, there is
one... A job that's perfect for you,
Tomo-boy.
22:
Okay. Got it. Then I'll help. Ikaros, will you
lend a hand too?
24:
Is that so? Well then, I suppose I'll take you
up on it...
28: Don't waste bullets! He's not over there!
29: Tch! Where'd that brat run off and hide?!
30: Tomo-boy! Come on out! You can't get away!
32: Yes, Master. Everyone went that way.
33: Dammit... That old hag, she tricked me...
34:
When she said help with the event, I figured
it'd be setting up or something...
35:
What the hell?! "Exciting Big Chase Game"?!
What do you mean, "Tomo-boy's the
target"?!
36:
Apparently it's a game where you chase
Master with air guns and just keep hitting
him with pellets...
37:
What kind of rules are those?! There isn't
even a winner or loser! Is this bullying?!
It's just plain bullying, right?!
39:
Ah! No, it's fine, Ikaros. Don't make such a
worried face.
40:
Even those old ladies won't go that
overboard, I'm sure.
42: Hey, everyone! Tomoki's here! Over there!
45:
Hah... hah... They're not chasing us
anymore, right?
46: Correct. They don't seem to be nearby.
47:
Okay. Let's hide while we can! Get in behind
that thing over there! Ikaros!
49:
Whoa, it's pretty cramped. Ikaros, you
okay?
52: I don't think I can fit in there...
53:
Hmm, yeah, it is pretty cramped. Can't be
helped. Ikaros, you go back home.
55:
I said I'm fine. Don't worry. It's just a
game. Besides, I'm the only one who needs
to be the target.
57:
Come on, hurry! The old ladies are gonna
find us!
59:
"Good luck in battle"... She's so dramatic,
that Ikaros.
60:
As long as I stay hidden right here, there's
no way the old ladies will find me...
61:
Well, I'll just kick back and hide till time
runs out...
62:
...Tomo-boy. Did you really think it'd go that
smoothly?
64: We figured out where you were ages ago...
65:
Wha?! H-how?! I thought there was no way
you'd ever find me here!
67:
Ikaros?! What are you doing here?! Didn't
you go home?
68:
No... I could never leave Master behind and
go home... So I was watching the whole time.
69: Watching? You were watching... from where?
70: From the sky above, the whole time...
71: The sky? The sky above...? No way!
72:
I-if you do that, of course they're gonna
find me~!
73: This is for missing the idol's show!
74:
This is for not getting to bring in a hunk
for the next festival!
76: And this is for ruining our festival!
82:
They didn't have to shoot me from
point-blank range... That was way too cruel,
everyone...
84:
Huh? Oh, it's fine. It's not your fault,
Ikaros. More importantly...
85: What should we do for dinner?
88: What should we do for dinner?
90:
Yeah. I was planning to check on things
and pick up groceries for dinner on the
way home, but...
91:
There's no way I'm buying anything in this
shopping district today!
93:
So for dinner... let's see... Let's order
pizza. From a place far away from the
shopping district.
95:
...And you'd better remember this, you old
hags! I'm definitely getting revenge for
this!
96:
And to start, I'm not buying anything here,
not just today, but for a good long while~!
97:
Go ahead and agonize over your falling
sales! This is my revenge! Wahahaha!
Wahahahahahaaa~!
99:
Wahahaha! Wahaha... Phew... Somehow, I
f-feel so empty...
100:
Are you okay? You didn't get hit by any
pellets, did you?
101: Me...? No, not a single one hit me...
108:
...? Thanks...? But I caused Master
trouble...
109:
When you get down to it, the clone's the
one to blame. And besides...
110:
You were worried about me, right, Ikaros?
So...
